old_text: The building height of a building (whether a new building, or an existing building asa result of an addition or alteration) must not exceed 15 m from ground level (mean).
new_text: The building height of a building (whether a new building, or an existing building asa result of an addition or alteration) must not exceed 22m from ground level (mean).
why: Sch 7 cl 2 now sets 22m, not 15 m.

old_text: (1) A new building must be located at least 5 m from any side or rear property boundary with land in a residential or conservation zone or at least 1m from any side or rear property boundary with land in any other zone.
new_text: (1) A building— (a) that is 12m or less in height must be located— (i) more than 5m from a side or rear property boundary with land in a residential or conservation zone, or (ii) more than 1m from a side or rear property boundary with land in another zone, or (b) that is more than 12m but less than 15m in height must be located— (i) more than 8m from a side or rear property boundary with land in a residential or conservation zone, or (ii) more than 2.5m from a side or rear property boundary with land in another zone, or (c) that is more than 15m but not greater than 22m in height must be located— (i) more than 10m from a side or rear property boundary with land in a residential or conservation zone, or (ii) more than 4m from a side or rear property boundary with land in another zone.
why: Sch 7 cl 4(1) now sets setbacks by building height.
